hash-wasm
https://github.com/Daninet/hash-wasm

Bundled verbatim as assets/vendor/hash-wasm-argon2.min.js (dist/argon2.umd.min.js
of version 4.12.0) and distributed to clients/basic/vendor/hash-wasm-argon2.min.js
by assets/refresh_assets.py.

hash-wasm declares no runtime dependencies. Its argon2 build embeds WebAssembly
compiled from its own C sources, which name these origins:

  argon2   based on Go's golang.org/x/crypto/argon2 (BSD-3-Clause)
  blake2b  BLAKE2 reference code (CC0-1.0, OpenSSL or Apache-2.0), taken
           here under CC0-1.0

hash-wasm's notice follows, then Go's.
